ALCHEMI experimental data for Ru-doped Ni3Al shows that Ru partitions preferentially onto the Al sublattice.
This indicates a strong tendency (of about four or five to one) for Ru to occupy an atomic sites associated with the Al sublattice compared with an atomic site associated with the Ni sublattice.
Partitioning of Ru onto Ni sites changes to about 24% when all corrections are taken into account, compared with the input 30%.
From these data it can be seen that there is good agreement between the results from different zones, and the relative partitioning of Ru onto Al sites is approximately 60%.
